coordinate_frame: World +X right/east, +Y north, +Z up. Device marks belong to the movable device frame.
rules: Assemble every pixel of the reference, including white cells, with one released stable cube per cell. Supply color does not assign permanent ownership.
The reference is north-up in the common world frame, centered at the declared assembly origin, with 51 mm cell-center spacing. The three versions share horizontal centers.
Pockets require physical seating. Printed and unmarked versions have the same target pattern. Previously correct cells can be disturbed by later contact.
Use robot actuation and real physical contact. No attachments to hands, state writes, teleportation, simulator reset, material edits or hidden evaluator access.
objective: Complete the task correctly and efficiently; account for planning, observation, communication, recovery and useful holding as well as simultaneous motion.

completion.xy_tolerance_role: diagnostic only; full footprint containment is the placement criterion

observation_contract.motion_screen: Robot-only geometry. Does not certify apparatus contact, insertion, shared load or cable clearance.

status: Suite development task; per-scene Oracle evidence is separate from policy performance.

process_contract.relay_support_proxy: Opposed jaw proximity within 0.2 mm and at least one actual force-bearing finger contact per gripper; not an individual load-share measurement
